name: spec-flow
description: Personal SDLC scaffolding for AI-assisted development. A lightweight, ephemeral 'contract' between user and AI drives each code change from captured idea to verified done; the durable layer (CLAUDE.md, ndr atoms, README) lives elsewhere. Lifecycle: capture -> draft -> implement -> close.

interface.longDescription: Contract-driven capture, drafting, implementation, verification, and close workflows.
defaultPrompt: Draft a contract for this change.
